scope: Three legal branches from the SAME naturally reached standard boss first charge at round 2, shield 4. No altered enemy state or injected resources. enemies.phase_rule: A charge uses one ordinary enemy action and publishes its committed next skill/targets. Heavy attack consumes the next ordinary action. Break cancels charge and skips only its pending heavy; no extra actions. Phase transition does not advance normal pattern. Phase 2 attack multiplier x1.2; wingpulse replaces one normal slot without advancing the rotation; an already-committed charge resolves first.
enemies.taunt: next single target locked x1.15; AOE unaffected
